about: Restart policy: at most `limit` starts within any `window_ms`, failed starts included. Each step is one start the supervisor is about to make (the sidecar ended, or the previous start failed), at `at_ms` from the first. `expect` is `start` (allowed — it counts from now on) or `down` (not allowed — the sidecar stays down until the app restarts it, so no step follows a `down`). A start counts while it is less than `window_ms` old.

cases.name: the default: three starts in five minutes, then down
a crash on every start uses the starts up at once
a start exactly one window old no longer counts
one millisecond short of the window it still counts
endings spread wider than the window never run out
no growing pause: a quick ending after a long quiet run still counts the starts in the window
a limit of zero never starts it again
